Theorem
[Gagliardo--Nirenberg--Sobolev inequality] ↗ def:sobolev-conjugate-exponent 1. ch5:5.6-thm-1\group Sobolev Inequalities

Assume $1 \le p < n$. There exists a constant $C$, depending only on $p$ and $n$, such that \[ (10) \quad \| u\| _{L^{p^*}(\R ^n)} \le C\| Du\| _{L^p(\R ^n)}, \] for all $u \in C_c^1(\R ^n)$.

Proof

\sketch For compactly supported smooth $u$, represent $u$ by the Newtonian kernel and apply Holder inequality with the integrability of $|x|^{1-n}$. Approximation by $C_c^\infty $ extends the estimate to $W^{1,p}$.

□
